name: Young jackfruit
description: Unripe jackfruit cooked as a vegetable — fibrous enough to pass for pulled meat.

tcm.note: The unripe fruit is neutral where the ripe is warming.

ayurveda.note: Shita and guru when unripe — the reverse of the sweet ripe fruit.

unani.note: Thanda; kathal is cooked as a sabzi across South Asia too.

guna.note: Fresh and simple — the sattvic default for plant food eaten close to how it grew.
